title: Untitled (Panoramic Mixed-Media Wall)
description: Large-scale horizontal collage assembled from multiple vertical panels, bordered top and bottom by rows of photographic portraits. Compact discs, sequins, painted targets, a framed inset, silver foil, blue ribbon stripes, and drawn suns populate the layered surface.
composition: horizontal multi-panel wall with portrait borders
keywords: multi-panel wall collage with portrait border
